The Quiet Garden

The quiet garden wakes slowly every morning. Dew settles on the broad leaves of the squash plants. A blackbird sings from the top of the fence.

By seven o'clock the sun reaches the vegetable beds. Gardeners arrive with watering cans and old gloves. They talk softly, as if the plants were still asleep.

Later in the day the garden grows busy. Bees move between the flowers, and children chase butterflies along the path. Evening brings calm once more.
